name: Adamas Trust, Inc. Common Stock
description: Adamas Trust Inc is an internally-managed REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes, in the business of acquiring, investing in, financing, and managing mainly mortgage-related single-family and multi-family residential assets. Its objective is to deliver long-term stable distributions to its stockholders over changing economic conditions through a combination of net interest spread and capital gains from a diversified investment portfolio. The company's investment portfolio includes credit-sensitive single-family and multi-family assets.
